lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One table, two halves of your off-duty life. The taquería, of course.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: So you're the famous friends. I've heard almost nothing. Suspicious.

beats.prompt: This was always going to happen.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: Has this one told you about the academy fitness test yet? No? OH.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your partner sets down the menu. Full attention. Terrible sign.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three phones come out. There is, apparently, photographic evidence.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: We were saving these for a wedding, honestly.

choices.label: Tell the story yourself — worse version.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 'Dinner's on me' buys exactly eleven seconds of mercy.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: Worth every cent, I'm sure. Now — the rope?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Money well wasted. The table votes to keep your partner.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: You got stuck WHERE on the rope climb?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You tell it worse than it was, because the table deserves that.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two worlds, one laugh. It fits.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 'Slander,' you declare, as three phones produce the evidence.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: I'm saving this one for later.
